tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(doctor): cover trailer presence, archetype guard, orphan classification

New/changed checks each get a direct test, plus a regression test that
reproduces the ethos-bfml/ethos-hy40 defect against the pre-fix RunAll
shape (an enabled repo with a removed commit-msg hook produced zero
FAILs). hookInvocationObserved is tested standalone, including against
the real hooks.PreCommit/hooks.CommitMsg bodies, eval resolution (the
lexical scanner's documented blind spot), git-unavailable, and a
timeout-bounded runaway hook.

Also fixes a hermeticity landmine the execution-based conversion
surfaced: several pre-existing seal-hook test fixtures used
`bd hooks run pre-commit || exit 1` as a stand-in foreign host line —
`bd` is a real installed CLI on this machine and `hooks run pre-commit`
happens to be a real, zero-exit subcommand, so the fixture accidentally
depended on an external binary's behavior once bodies are actually
executed. Replaced with `true`, a dependency-free POSIX builtin.

Mission: m-2026-09-10-001
EOF
)"
